title: 第一卷 第12章 快醒醒，打上门了
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季望棉睡到日上三竿，舒服地伸了个懒腰。

院子里静悄悄。

她揉着眼睛，

“早饭，中午等我回来做饭，钱票是别人还回来的，你收着。”

仔细看，铝饭盒下面压着一些钱和票，数了数，二百二十几块钱呢。

票据也不少，肥皂票，澡票，洗脸盆、暖水瓶、毛巾、针线、搪瓷缸……

正好有棉花票，季望棉打算还给芬华姐。

有借有还再借不难！顺便她想问下芬华姐要不要去洗澡，两个人还能互相搓个背。

坐下来吃了早饭，一碗白米稀饭，萧临戍怕她吃不饱，煮了三个鸡蛋，季望棉只吃一个，剩下的两个踹进兜里，去了隔壁。

“呜呜呜……我不敢了！”

“爸爸，嗝，我错了，别打我！”

“我举报，是哥哥让我藏床下面的，你打他别打我！”

“小二子，你是叛徒，你出卖我！”

“呜呜呜……哥哥，我屁股太疼了，你先挨一会，等我恢复了再翻口供，证明你是好人。”

“啊……我打死也不投降，让敌人的……啊……”

季望舒伸头看去，俩孩子全都趴在长板凳上，抹着眼泪，田金树手拿着拖鞋，打得啪啪响。

实打实的一下子，屁股蛋子因为受力一颤一颤的。

王芬华更是掐着腰，应该是气狠了，手都在抖：“你们俩要翻天！敢藏在我跟你爸的床底下，树子，你给我打，狠狠地打。”

谁懂啊。

两口子衣服都脱一半了，正入佳境，床底下传来小孩的笑声，王芬华吓得一哆嗦。她说有声音，田金树正在兴头上，哄着她说没有，让她老实躺着。

刚躺下，又听到一声笑。

王芬华想下床开灯，皮小子一左一右抓着她的脚腕。

那一下。

她好像看到了列祖列宗冲她招手！

魂都飞出二里地了！

王芬华后槽牙都要咬碎了：“给我打死这俩糟心，诶，棉棉你来了！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ji Wangmian slept until three o'clock in the morning and stretched out comfortably.

The yard was quiet.

She rubbed her eyes,

"Breakfast, wait for me to come back at noon to cook. The money and receipts are returned by others, so you keep them."

Looking carefully, I saw some money and tickets pressed under the aluminum lunch box. I counted it, and it was more than two hundred and twenty yuan.

There are also a lot of bills, including soap tickets, bath tickets, wash basins, thermos bottles, towels, needlework, enamel tubs...

Ji Wangmian happened to have cotton tickets, and he planned to return them to Sister Fenhua.

It’s not difficult to borrow something and borrow it again!By the way, she wanted to ask Sister Fenhua if she wanted to take a shower so that the two of them could rub each other's backs.

They sat down to have breakfast, a bowl of white rice porridge. Xiao Linshu was afraid that she would not be full, so he boiled three eggs. Ji Wangmian only ate one, and kicked the remaining two into his pocket and went to the next door.

"Uuuuuuuuuah...I don't dare anymore!"

"Dad, hiccup, I was wrong, don't hit me!"

"I'm reporting it. My brother asked me to hide him under the bed. If you hit him, don't hit me!"

"Xiao Erzi, you are a traitor, you betrayed me!"

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu...Brother, my butt hurts too much. You can bear it for a while. When I recover, you can then recant your confession and prove that you are a good person."

"Ah... I won't surrender even if I die, let the enemy... ah..."

Ji Wangshu stretched his head and looked around. He saw that both children were lying on the bench, wiping their tears. Tian Jinshu was holding slippers and making a snapping sound.

For a moment, my buttocks trembled due to the force.

Wang Fenhua pinched her waist, she must have been furious, her hands were shaking: "You two are going to shake things up! If you dare to hide under my and your dad's bed, Shuzi, you beat me, hard."

Who knows?

The couple had half taken off their clothes and were in a good mood. A child's laughter came from under the bed, and Wang Fenhua trembled with fright.She said there was a sound, but Tian Jinshu was in high spirits and coaxed her to say there was no sound and asked her to lie down.

Just as I lay down, I heard another laugh.

Wang Fenhua wanted to get out of bed and turn on the light, but Pi Xiaozi grabbed her ankles from left to right.

That moment.

She seemed to see her ancestors waving to her!

The soul flew two miles away!

Wang Fenhua's back teeth were almost broken: "Kill these two bastards for me, hey, Mianmian, you're here!"
